mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_connection_metadata (conn_id, invi_msg_id, user_id, tenant_id, device_id, status) VALUES (#{connId}, #{inviMsgId}, #{userId}, #{tenantId}, #{deviceId}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT connection_metadata_id, conn_id, invi_msg_id, user_id, tenant_id, device_id, status, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_connection_metadata WHERE connection_metadata_id = #{id}
SELECT connection_metadata_id, conn_id, invi_msg_id, user_id, tenant_id, device_id, status, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_connection_metadata WHERE conn_id = #{connId}
SELECT connection_metadata_id, conn_id, invi_msg_id, user_id, tenant_id, device_id, status, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_connection_metadata WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT connection_metadata_id, conn_id, invi_msg_id, user_id, tenant_id, device_id, status, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_connection_metadata WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT connection_metadata_id, conn_id, invi_msg_id, user_id, tenant_id, device_id, status, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_connection_metadata WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT connection_metadata_id, conn_id, invi_msg_id, user_id, tenant_id, device_id, status, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_connection_metadata WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM tb_connection_metadata WHERE conn_id = #{connId}
